_: Every place a way stands in non-sea water deeper than 0.3 m, read from the shipped water record (the entity and its kind come from the signed hydrology graph; only the depth is measured). `banks` are the two DRY approach points of the run: the way sample just before it enters the water and the sample just after it leaves. Generated by `python3 -m worldgen.derive_crossings` — never hand-edited. The band is set on SPAN AND DEPTH: a ford is narrower than 20 m and no deeper than 1.2 m, the small-draft hull depth the docks are dredged to. Which of the `ferry`-band crossings actually becomes a ferry is authored in `world/sources/routes/travel-services.json`, against a causal reason, not against this file.
